MiniMax H3 on Mac: files, RAM and published times

MiniMax H3 is an open-weights model that generates video with synchronized stereo audio from text, optional first and last frames, or reference media. The open release is H3-Base, and on a Mac it runs through community MLX, Metal and ComfyUI routes.

MiniMax · Updated 2026-10-24
Answer

MiniMax H3 runs on a Mac with 24 GB or more. A published run on M4 Pro · 24 GB used the Official FL2VA BF16 (MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3) build (source, 2026-08-11).

Separate prior written authorization is required when commercial products and services generate more than 20 million US dollars in yearly revenue.

MiniMax H3 is a video-and-audio generation model, not MiniMax M3, which is a separate text LLM.

Table 3

Does it fit your NVIDIA GPU's VRAM?

Runs · Stated means the linked model card, app maker or NVIDIA says a GPU with that much VRAM runs the model; Runs · Published names the card of a dated run. Fits with offload means the main model weights fit in VRAM with a 15% margin but the full set does not: the text encoder and VAE run from system RAM, which is slower. Exceeds VRAM means even the main weights are too large for the card. Mac runs never count here.

Which Mac software routes are listed?

  • Argus-AiTeam/minimax-h3-mac (MLX streaming)

    Community

    Formats: safetensors, mlx. Memory policy: DiT weights can stream from SSD.

    Sources: Argus MLX route README

  • ComfyUI

    Official

    Formats: safetensors, gguf. Memory policy: component stages stay resident.

    On Apple Silicon ComfyUI runs on PyTorch MPS, not MLX. GGUF files need the separate city96/ComfyUI-GGUF custom node. Resident size is the sum of the weights, an upper bound: ComfyUI can unload models between stages and publishes no per-model Mac peak.

    Sources: ComfyUI README · ComfyUI system requirements · ComfyUI CLI arguments · ComfyUI-GGUF README

  • antirez/h3.c (Metal)

    Community

    Formats: safetensors. Memory policy: DiT weights can stream from SSD.

    The ssd-streaming policy applies only with the --ssd-streaming flag; the default keeps the DiT resident.

    Sources: h3.c README

  • ddalcu/mlx-serve

    Community

    Formats: mlx. Memory policy: component stages stay resident.

    Sources: MLX Serve 4-bit pack card

  • stable-diffusion.cpp

    Official

    Formats: gguf, safetensors. Memory policy: component stages stay resident.

    C/C++ runner with Metal on Mac and CUDA on NVIDIA. It reads GGUF and safetensors, and its docs keep a page per model family. Resident size is the sum of the weights, an upper bound.

    Sources: stable-diffusion.cpp README, backends

What does the official configuration say?

"The official SGLang example runs on 4 GPUs (--num-gpus 4). No official MiniMax Mac memory figure was found."

Source: MiniMax-H3 model card · Read 2026-10-24.

What known issues should you check?

  • Known issue 1

    The open release is H3-Base. H3-Context-IR and H3-Regenerate-2K are not included, so the local checkpoint is not the complete hosted 2K workflow.

    Source: MiniMax-H3 model card · Read 2026-10-24

  • Known issue 2

    A 362-frame 608x352 run with the 4-bit pack on a 128 GB M4 Max failed under memory pressure and swapping; the first diffusion step alone took 79 minutes.

    Source: Zenn: MiniMax H3 on M4 Max 128GB · Read 2026-10-24

  • Known issue 3

    Argus reports peak memory footprint for the BF16 run and maximum RSS for the INT8 run, and says Metal memory follows different accounting than RSS, so the two figures are not directly comparable.

    Source: Argus MLX route README (BF16 run) · Read 2026-10-24

Frequently asked questions

Can MiniMax H3 run on a 24 GB Mac?

Yes, with block streaming. Argus MLX ran the BF16 weights on a 24 GB M4 Pro at 1344x768 and 124 frames in 2,878.7 s, and the calibrated INT8 DiT ran 768x448 in 1,378.0 s. Both are end-to-end times for a clip of about 5 seconds.

What is the smallest Mac that ran H3?

A 16 GB M1 MacBook Air made a 22-frame 352x608 clip in 17 minutes with a 4-step Turbo LoRA, or 36 minutes with an 8-step LoRA, in Bambushu's light ComfyUI setup. Clips of 56 frames and more ran out of GPU memory.

Is MiniMax H3 licensed for commercial use?

Not everywhere. The MiniMax H3 Community License excludes the European Union, the United Kingdom, the Republic of Korea and the United States of America, and asks for separate written authorization above 20 million US dollars in yearly revenue.
